attachments.origin_landmark: sternal head: manubrium; clavicular head: medial third of clavicle
attachments.insertion_landmark: mastoid process and lateral superior nuchal line

actions: unilateral: laterally flexes neck to the same side + rotates face to the opposite side
bilateral: flexes neck / protracts head, assists forced inspiration by fixing/elevating the sternum

functional_compartments.name: Sternal head

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Rounder, more superficial head arising from the manubrium.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Located at the lower border of the superior third of the muscle. Half-dose injections targeted here matched the effect of a full standard dose.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Delnooz CCS, Veugen LC, Pasman JW, Lapatki BG, van Dijk JP, van de Warrenburg BPC. 'The clinical utility of botulinum toxin injections targeted at the motor endplate zone in cervical dystonia.' Eur J Neurol 21(12):1486 (2014), doi:10.1111/ene.12517 -- high-density surface EMG in 18 cervical dystonia patients

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_to: most medial point of the clavicle
motor_endplate_zones.method: cadaveric dissection, motor entry point and intramuscular motor point mapping
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Whole-muscle-mass reference (does not distinguish sternal from clavicular head), complementary to the surface-EMG point above. 97% of motor entry points and 85% of intramuscular motor points fell in this band. Used clinically for a torticollis/cervical dystonia mass in the UPPER SCM. Ultrasound guidance is recommended here specifically: the great auricular nerve crosses the reference line at 22%, the external jugular vein at 28%.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Lee JH, Lee BN, Han SH, An XC, Chung RH, 'The effective zone of botulinum toxin A injections in the sternocleidomastoid muscle', Surg Radiol Anat 33(3):185 (2010), doi:10.1007/s00276-010-0729-y -- 35 specimens from 20 cadavers. Retrieved via PubMed.

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_to: most medial point of the clavicle
motor_endplate_zones.method: cadaveric dissection, motor entry point and intramuscular motor point mapping
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Whole-muscle-mass reference, the alternative zone used clinically for a torticollis/cervical dystonia mass in the LOWER SCM. The transverse cervical nerve crosses the reference line at 45%, just proximal to this band.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Lee JH, Lee BN, Han SH, An XC, Chung RH, 'The effective zone of botulinum toxin A injections in the sternocleidomastoid muscle', Surg Radiol Anat 33(3):185 (2010), doi:10.1007/s00276-010-0729-y -- 35 specimens from 20 cadavers. Retrieved via PubMed.

functional_compartments.name: Clavicular head

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Broader, flatter, deeper head arising from the medial clavicle; the two heads are separated by a palpable triangular gap (the lesser supraclavicular fossa) at their origin.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Reported for sternocleidomastoid as a whole; the two heads were not separately mapped.
